content.short: Wam is a crypto-gaming platform for skill-based tournaments where players can win rewards in WAM Tokens.
content.description: Wam is a crypto-gaming platform where players join skill-based tournaments to win rewards in WAM Tokens. Players can design their own games with AI technology, trade NFTs earned in tournaments on the marketplace, and grow their player profiles by securing victories. All games and tournaments are skill-based, and players can monitor their progress in real time by viewing tournament rankings. The 2023 roadmap outlines features such as new games, user-generated tournaments, and AI-powered fraud detection.
